object.name: evi_transratio
object.digest: Convert semitones to pitch and vica versa
object.description: Like the Max <o>transratio</o> abstraction but with multiple choices for input/output conversion. Clamps internally so that output never produces -inf or nan.

inlets.name: input
inlets.digestauto: value in either pitch\, octave\, semitones\, cents or ratio

outlets.name: output
outlets.digestauto: value in either ratio\, semitones\, hz or pitch

attributes.name: base
attributes.description: Set the tuning for the conversion around A = 440.

attributes.name: input
attributes.description: int, one of: 0=pitch, 1=octave, 2=semitones, 3=cents, 4=ratio. Sets the input to the convertor.

attributes.name: offset
attributes.description: Hz and pitch convertion assume middle C = 60. Via @offset you can change this to anything you need.

attributes.name: output
attributes.description: int, one of: 0=ratio, 1=semitones, 2=hz, 3=pitch. Sets the output from the convertor.
